facts.fact: At the 11 August 2026 launch, the Uganda Muslim Medical Bureau said many Health Centre IIIs lack computers and connectivity to submit reports, with Ziiru Health Centre III carrying its report physically to Buvuma district headquarters, and the in-charge of St Francis Kijjaguzo Health Centre III spoke of a transition still to be made from the manual Health Management Information System to the ministry's digital tools.
